name: overlap
description: Free group scheduling without accounts. Share a link, mark your times, see where everyone overlaps.

scripts.worker:dev: cd worker && wrangler d1 migrations apply overlap --local && wrangler dev
scripts.worker:deploy: cd worker && (wrangler d1 migrations apply overlap --remote || (echo 'Retrying migrations in 5s...' && sleep 5 && wrangler d1 migrations apply overlap --remote)) && wrangler deploy
